dark.$description: Anchor hue for the dark mode neutral ramp (steps 1–12). Choose a near-black with a whisper of brand chroma — pure greys read clinical.

light.$description: Anchor hue for the light mode neutral ramp. Choose a near-white / very light grey, slightly tinted toward the brand for warmth.

primary.$description: Primary brand colour. Drives the action ramp (CTAs, links, focus rings). Pick the hue with the strongest brand recall — APCA Silver requires Lc ≥ 60 on body text against this at step 9.

secondary.$description: Supporting brand colour used for secondary actions, selected states, and informational accents. Should be visually distinct from primary and tertiary in hue (≥ 30° apart in OKLCH).

tertiary.$description: Third brand accent for promos, highlights, and decorative surfaces. Used sparingly; must not compete with primary for action affordance.

error.$description: Destructive / failure state ramp (delete, validation errors). Stick to a red — users have learned the convention.

info.$description: Neutral informational ramp (toasts, hints). Usually a blue. Distinct from primary to avoid action-vs-info confusion.

success.$description: Positive confirmation ramp (saved, completed). Usually a green.

warning.$description: Cautionary ramp (unsaved changes, risky actions). Usually an amber / yellow. Note: yellow is APCA-difficult — verify Lc against onWarning text.

shadow.$description: dark mode shadow tint strength. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.

surface.$description: dark mode surface tint strength. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.

source.$description: dark mode shared structural-surface/shadow hue source. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.

shadow.$description: light mode shadow tint strength. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.

surface.$description: light mode surface tint strength. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.

source.$description: light mode shared structural-surface/shadow hue source. Brand-specific primitive behind the corresponding theme tint control.
